changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS cmr_user ( id BIGINT PRIMARY KEY COMMENT '雪花主键', username VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL COMMENT '登录名', password VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL COMMENT 'BCrypt 密码', nickname VARCHAR(64) COMMENT '显示名', role VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'user' COMMENT 'admin/operator/user', status CHAR(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT '1' COMMENT '1启用0停用', create_id BIGINT COMMENT '创建人', create_time DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, update_id BIGINT, update_time DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, del_flag CHAR(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'F' COMMENT '逻辑删除', UNIQUE KEY uk_username (username) ) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COMMENT='cmr 用户';

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS cmr_feedback ( id BIGINT PRIMARY KEY COMMENT '雪花主键', biz_no VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL COMMENT 'FBK 编号', search_id BIGINT NOT NULL COMMENT '关联检索历史', type VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL COMMENT 'inaccurate/ranking/wrong_source/zero_result', description VARCHAR(1024), status VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending' COMMENT 'pending/processing/closed', target VARCHAR(32) COMMENT 'strategy/datasource/backfill', result_note VARCHAR(512), handler_id BIGINT, create_id BIGINT, create_time DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, update_id BIGINT, update_time DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, del_flag CHAR(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'F', UNIQUE KEY uk_biz_no (biz_no), KEY idx_status (status), KEY idx_search (search_id) ) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COMMENT='cmr 反馈单';
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS cmr_recommend_word ( id BIGINT PRIMARY KEY COMMENT '雪花主键', biz_no VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL COMMENT 'REC 编号', word VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, scene VARCHAR(64) DEFAULT 'all', enabled TINYINT(1) DEFAULT 1, sort INT DEFAULT 0, create_id BIGINT, create_time DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, update_id BIGINT, update_time DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, del_flag CHAR(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'F', UNIQUE KEY uk_biz_no (biz_no), UNIQUE KEY uk_word (word) ) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COMMENT='cmr 运营推荐词';
